verdict.rationale: Kimi does ship an API: the Kimi Code API is OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, and there is a separate Open Platform LLM API. So this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The model tier names (K2.8 Preview, K2.7 Code HighSpeed) identify model versions, not a versioned API contract with deprecation terms, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
